issues.legal_issue: An appellate court deciding an appeal in a pre-emption suit must take account of a legal bar that came into force after the decree under appeal when confirming that decree would itself amount to passing a decree in the suit.
material_facts: A suit sought to enforce a right of pre-emption, and the trial court decreed the suit; the lower appellate court affirmed that decree.
While a further appeal was pending, a new law came into force prohibiting courts from passing decrees in pre-emption suits.
The High Court allowed the appeal and dismissed the suit.
issues.conclusion: The High Court was right to allow the appeal and dismiss the suit because confirming the decree would have amounted to passing its own decree in a pre-emption suit after the statutory bar had come into force.
issues.legal_principle: An appeal is in the nature of a rehearing, and an appellate court may take account of facts and events arising after the decree under appeal when moulding relief. When an appellate court confirms a decree, it passes a decree of its own. Under section 3 of the Punjab Pre-emption (Repeal) Act, 1973, no court could pass a decree in a pre-emption suit after the Act commenced. The Court relied on Lachweshwar Prasad Shukul v. Keshwar Lal Chaudhury, [1940] F.C.R. 84, and Kristnama Chariviar v. Mangammal, [1902] I.L.R. 26 Mad. 91, at pp. 95–96.

rule.if: appeal_in_preemption_suit and lower_court_decreed_preemption and legal_bar_took_effect_during_appeal and law_prohibited_decreeing_preemption_suits and appellate_confirmation_would_be_its_own_decree

predicates.appeal_in_preemption_suit: The proceeding is an appeal in a suit seeking to enforce a right of pre-emption.
predicates.lower_court_decreed_preemption: A court below granted a decree enforcing the claimed right of pre-emption.
predicates.legal_bar_took_effect_during_appeal: A legal bar to granting the requested decree took effect while the appeal was pending.
predicates.law_prohibited_decreeing_preemption_suit: The law in force prohibited courts from granting decrees in suits seeking pre-emption.
predicates.appellate_confirmation_would_be_its_own_: Confirming the decree below would constitute the appellate court passing a decree of its own.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns a decree granting pre-emption and a prohibition on granting such decrees takes effect while the appeal is pending, the appellate court must allow the appeal and dismiss the suit if confirmation would itself amount to granting a decree.
